criteria.evidence: Removes the nightly trigger, four-job matrix, all-module enrollment and per-job floor of 60. The manual job targets one route function.
criteria.reason: The shipped configuration ends the broad recurring work and keeps the score informational.

criteria.evidence: Keeps the focused tests in normal CI and seeds a wrong endpoint. Adds a destination assertion only if the existing tests miss the fault.
criteria.reason: The seeded fault directly decides whether a regression is needed. The assertion allows valid alternate bends.

criteria.evidence: Stops the unsuccessful nightly lane. Reconsiders recurrence only after a completed target-CI baseline, measured headroom, actionable findings beyond the regression and a named owner who handles results.
criteria.reason: Each prerequisite addresses a specific missing justification for recurring runner use.

criteria.evidence: Removes the schedule, four-job matrix, all-module enrollment and score floor. Manual dispatch selects a named route function.
criteria.reason: The proposed recurring expansion and threshold do not ship.

criteria.evidence: Preserves the suite on its existing trigger. Seeds a source-for-destination fault on a fixture and extends the endpoint check only if the suite misses it.
criteria.reason: The fault check decides whether a focused assertion is needed. A distinct unanswered question is required for the optional 30-minute mutation trial.

criteria.evidence: Disables the failing schedule. Future recurrence needs a complete target-runner baseline within budget, an actionable fault class beyond the regression and a named owner accepting notification and triage.
criteria.reason: A measured run, added detection value and accepted responsibility must all precede recurrence.

criteria.evidence: Replaces the schedule and four-job matrix with one manual runner for one route module and drops the proposed score floor.
criteria.reason: The pilot limits enrollment and introduces neither scheduled execution nor a score gate.

criteria.evidence: Keeps existing focused tests on their current triggers. Samples at most 10 mutants in 30 minutes and adds a regression when a survivor reveals a missed observable behavior.
criteria.reason: The pilot bounds runner use and gives the owner a concrete decision about which surviving fault merits a test.

criteria.evidence: Removes the unsuccessful nightly run and requires an owner before dispatch. Captures actual target-runner cost and holds scheduling pending a completed baseline and owner review of cost and actionable findings.
criteria.reason: Measured capacity and evidence of a test gap go to an identified reviewer before recurrence is considered.
